procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial review in this session; no spawn, resume, fork, peer review or producer/planner record inspection. Read the pinned packet, complete literal case, rules, rubric, compact method/addendum and adapter. Verified pinned input bytes and each exact PNG header/hash. Read the five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing without following their unlisted embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty: zero source-image opens and zero protected-layout reads are applicable. Actually opened and visually inspected all 15 exact poster assets with tools.view_image(detail:'original'), emitting each result: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Completed that sequence before beginning the first copy transcription, judgment or score. Retained first reads in session memory. Subsequently made one exact pinned native revisit for M2 invitation spacing and one for M3 invitation spacing; both initial readings are preserved. Actual poster opens: 15 initial plus these 2 explained revisits. Usage PNGs are 720x405 and thumbnail PNGs 320x180, inspected at their supplied sizes; no crops, replacement images or image edits. Session identity is not invented; session_id is null. Hash/header checks and helper success are not claimed as visual opens.
